Red crosses can be seen when the '''Grizzly''' is healing. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Claw}}''' - Attacks a nearby tower. Any tower caught in the range of the claw attack is stunned for a while. |ability3 = '''{{WikiAb|Beehive}}''' - Chews on a beehive which makes it immune to most forms of damage. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Grizzly''' was a bear that only appeared in [[Eggy Island]] hard mode as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It did not appear in easy mode. The '''Grizzly''' had a high amount of health (though it had 250 less health than [[Sir Hopsalot]] in hard mode). It walked slightly faster than [[Sir Hopsalot]]. It had three abilities. ''Heal'' healed '''Grizzly''' by about 50 health. The ''Claw'' attack stunned nearby towers within its range. The ''Beehive'' ability made it immune to most forms of damage. ==Appearance== The '''Grizzly''' had the appearance of a brown bear. On its torso, it had partial white fur. It had three sharpened claws on each hand and appeared to be wearing a partial black mask. ==Strategy== *Try not to leave the '''Grizzly''' unaccompanied for too long. **If it crosses to the other island and you have no towers there, the '''Grizzly''' will be able to use its ''Heal'' ability which will most certainly end the game, even if the '''Grizzly''' is at low health. **The [[Enforcer (Legacy)|Enforcer]]'s [[SWAT Van]] or the [[Military Base]] [[units]] can collide with the '''Grizzly''', even when it uses its ''Beehive'' ability, dealing full collision damage. *Try to place towers away from the path so that they are not targeted by the '''Grizzly'''. **The [[Ranger|Outlaw]] is the ideal tower to use for the '''Grizzly''' as they are normally out of range for this attack. *When the '''Grizzly''' is performing its ''Beehive'' ability, do not activate any new abilities (such as the [[Commander]]'s ''Call of Arms'') as they will have no effect on the '''Grizzly'''. ==Trivia== *The sound '''Grizzly''' made when eating the beehive was the same sound the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Heavy Heavy], from ''Team Fortress 2'', makes when eating his [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Sandvich Sandvich]. *The head of the '''Grizzly''' was a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|522091099|Undead Teddy}} accessory from the ROBLOX catalog. ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Grizzly''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Grizzly''' removed. {{EggyIsland|[[Beehive]]
